Name: Nyapu Style for the 'Immersive Children - Portraits and Sprites' Mod
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

I absolutely adore nyapu's portrait for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children[/url]﻿ mod, however I like to follow Xiao's recommended immersive experience by first starting with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17054]Immersive Unique Children Talk[/url]﻿ first, then swapping to the Farmer's children for the 'grown up' children. BUT there's no matching portraits to make the mods work smoothly, so this is where this mod comes in!

With over 500+ Portraits (yes really, 518 to be exact) to choose from there's something for everyone.

If you want to use these hairstyles for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children[/url]﻿ mod you're in luck! I've released a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27542]separate patch[/url]﻿ which can be used with said mod ^-^

For an RRRR specific patch checkout my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28741]RRRR Immersive Children Portraits and Sprite Patch[/url]﻿!
 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a replacer mod - meaning it replaces the original mod's pngs. Here's a step by step guide on how to use this mod:

[list=1]
[*]Install the '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites[/url]﻿' Mod
[*]Download and unzip this mod and drag and drop the '[CP] Immersive Children' folder located in 'Nyapu Style Immersive Children Portraits/[CP] Immersive Children' [u][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]over the original mod's file[/url]﻿[/b][/u]

[*]When the popup says to override some of the original files click yes
[*]You're done!

[/list]

If you plan to use the alternative portraits in the 'Extras' folder you'll need to do a couple more steps to get them working. Here's a step by step guide on how to use this mod:

[list=1]
[*]Install the '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]Immersive Children- Portraits and Sprites[/url]﻿' Mod
[*]Download and unzip this mod and open the 'Nyapu Style Immersive Children Portraits/Extras' folder path and have a look at the different extra skin tones and hair colours
[*]Choose a style, for example 'Ysabelle_Girl_5' and rename it to 'Ysabelle_Girl_W', and drag and drop it over the original mods portrait's folder.

[*]When the popup says to override an image click yes
[*]You're done!

[/list]
[list=1]

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img][/url]

Portraits for Vanilla Spouses,[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753] Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿


[img]https://i.ibb.co/y0bTYfR/credits.png[/img]
[/list]
I can't thank [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu/mods?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]﻿ enough for open asset use permissions in order to make this mod possible: Checkout out their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Portraits[/url]﻿! Based on the Farmer's Children Nyapu Portrait mod, checkout my hair patch for the The Farmer's children mod!

Thank you xiaoleiwen for giving permission to release this patch and for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21412]original mod[/url]﻿ :>

Thanks Flashshifter and the rest of the SVE team for the open asset use permission - allowing me to create a patch for SVE Characters.

Thanks Rafseazz and the rest of the RSV team for the open asset use permission for RSV mods - allowing me to create a patch for RSV Characters.

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
